data.summary: ddflow doctor reports 4 items with no title of their own: 'Bug list sorting by severity with dependency edges for CLI and MCP' (id used as title), DX-review-findings-show, T1, T2. task add / item creation accepts an empty title instead of refusing, so list/board rows show only the id.
